## Importing the Tiff and Naming it
### Getting the correct libraries
```{r}
library(boxr)
library(terra)
```

 ``` {r}
 box_auth()
 ```


#### Creating function to convert tiff to shp
```{r}
# Load required package
if (!requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("terra")
}

# Function to convert GeoTIFF to Shapefile
convert_tiff_to_shp <- function(tiff_path, shp_path) {
  tryCatch({
    # Validate input file
    if (!file.exists(tiff_path)) {
      stop("Error: The specified TIFF file does not exist.")
    }
    if (!grepl("\\.tif(f)?$", tiff_path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      stop("Error: Input file must have a .tif or .tiff extension.")
    }
    
    # Read the raster
    cat("Reading TIFF file...\n")
    r <- rast(tiff_path)
    
    # Check if raster has values
    if (all(is.na(values(r)))) {
      stop("Error: The raster contains only NA values.")
    }
    
    # Convert raster to polygons
    cat("Converting raster to polygons...\n")
    # dissolve=TRUE merges adjacent cells with the same value
    polygons <- as.polygons(r, dissolve = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Save polygons as shapefile
    cat("Saving shapefile...\n")
    writeVector(polygons, shp_path, overwrite = TRUE)
    
    cat("Conversion successful! Shapefile saved at:", shp_path, "\n")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Conversion failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
}

# Example usage:
# Replace with your file paths
#tiff_file <- "input.tif"
#shp_file  <- "output.shp"

#convert_tiff_to_shp(tiff_file, shp_file)
```
